column3: BSB adds “This is”; “soon” renders τάχει (“with speed”); “He made it known by sending” recasts “He signified [it], having sent.”

BSB recasts the verse: “who testifies to everything he saw. This is the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ”; the Greek says he “testified to the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ, whatever he saw.”
BSB adds “aloud,” “this,” and a second “blessed are”; “obey” renders τηροῦντες (“keeping”).
“The province of” is added before “Asia.”
BSB follows the critical text with “who loves us” and “has released us”; the Textus Receptus has “loved us” and “washed us.”
BSB follows the critical text with “a kingdom” (the Textus Receptus has “kings”).
“Even” is added; “So shall it be!” renders ναὶ (“Yes”).
BSB follows the critical text with “the Lord God” and no “the Beginning and the End,” which is in the Textus Receptus.
BSB follows the critical text with “in Jesus” and “testimony about Jesus”; the Textus Receptus has “Jesus Christ” twice. “My” before “testimony” is added.
Close to the Greek.

BSB follows the critical text with “the seven churches” and no “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last” or “in Asia,” which are in the Textus Receptus. “Scroll” renders βιβλίον (“book”).
“Then” renders “And”; BSB leaves out “there” (ἐκεῖ).
BSB follows the critical text with “the lampstands” (no “seven”).
“The hair of His head” recasts “His head and the hairs”; “blazing fire” renders “a flame of fire.”
“Polished” is added; “the roar of many waters” renders “the voice of many waters.”
“At its brightest” renders “in its strength.”
“Like a dead man” renders “as though dead.”
BSB adds “now.” “Death and Hades” keeps the critical-text order; the Textus Receptus has “Hades and Death” and adds “Amen.”
“Will happen” renders “are about to take place.”
BSB adds “the” before “angels” and leaves out the second “you saw” with the critical text.
